text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I'm here with some of the best runners
around to
ask them their thoughts on
their careers. Starting
off...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The races I have run ere comprise only
the
introduction to my career. Thus, the
proverbial
die has been cast!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now pay close attention! I will charge
like Julius Caesar through the
battlefield. I must present the
luster of
the Overlord to the masses!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you're ready to go! I see,
I see...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
And now, I'd like to hear your opinion,
Zenno
Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Well, u-um! I'm n-not sure what to say...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please, no need to be nervous. You
can relax.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
According to my notes, you admire Rob
Roy
MacGregor, a notable hero in
history... Could you
elaborate as to why?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you know about Rob Roy
MacGregor, the
Scottish legend of
yore?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I do admire him! As a bearer of the
same name, I strive to not tarnish his
legacy. He was a
man who stood up for
the weak!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of him, I'm generally interested
in books of his heroic tales that have
shaped his image
until today. One of my
favorites would be...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit! Keep it up!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Opera O! Why must I be Opera O?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This eternal question comes with an
answer. As I continue to stare inwards at
mine own self, at
last... a ray of hope is
found!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Of course, comparing historical figures
to their literary interpretations can
reveal certain deviations from truth. But
if you only consider those stories a mere
fraction of real history...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
This sudden surge of information would

overwhelm even the great listener,
Prince
Shotoku!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Otonashi skillfully draws out the
Umamusume's thoughts and passions,
resulting in an exciting
and dynamic
interview!
